best_pick_ranker.description: Best Pick ranker (SPEC-5): does calibrated_probability, key_number_distance, or sweep_robustness order weekly pick quality well enough to choose the pool's one Best Pick per week?

windows.notes: 51 weeks / 748 picks / 51 top-1. sweep_robustness top-1 54.90% vs 49.33% all-pick (+5.57 pts, P+=0.7955, week-blocked [-8.36, +19.09]) clears the predeclared 0.75 screen gate and earns one opener confirmation; interval still crosses zero, hence unresolved. key_number_distance -6.19 pts (P+=0.17) and calibrated_probability -8.16 pts (P+=0.0925) both fail. Seasons previously mined by pbp_drive_bundle [2013, 2017] (rule 4 overlap, disclosed).

best_pick_ranker_opener.description: SPEC-5 confirmation arm: does sweep_robustness top-1 (the signal that cleared the [2013, 2015] screen at P+=0.7955) still rank Best Pick quality when graded at the Tuesday opener the pool uses? Player profile -- ranks the picks we actually publish.

windows.notes: 35 weeks / 456 resolved picks / 35 top-1, player profile, graded at the Tuesday opener. sweep_robustness top-1 60.0% (21/35) vs 51.32% all-pick, +8.68 pts, week-blocked [-7.00, +22.88], P+=0.865 -- clears SPEC-5's predeclared 0.75 confirmation gate. Kendall tau +0.067 (p=0.099). Sweep loop reproduced opener_pick_evaluation's weekly fit to max|diff|=0.0. Confirmed means 'cleared its predeclared gate on 35 top-1 picks', not 'established': the interval crosses zero. Window intersects the mined 2018-2025 ledger (acknowledged); inherits best_pick_ranker's spent [2013, 2015]. RE-READ 2026-08-18 (no re-run, no window): sweep_robustness TIED in 24 of 35 weeks, so in most weeks the ranker ranked nothing and the top-1 was selected by team-name alphabetical order. Tie-break-agnostic top-1 is 52.24% vs 51.32% all-pick, delta +0.92 pts (not +8.68), P+ 0.536-0.554 under D2 widening -- never near the 0.75 gate. The recorded 60.0% sits at the 95.4th percentile of its own tie-break-luck distribution, and flipping 3 of 21 correct top-1 picks takes +8.68 to +0.11. Downgraded confirmed -> unresolved. PLAY DECISION UNCHANGED: sweep_robustness still chooses the weekly Best Pick, because both alternatives are measured negatives (calibrated_probability -8.16, key_number_distance -6.19) and the pool is forced picks; budget the edge at ~+0.9 pts. See docs/best_pick_ranker.md Tier-2 re-read section and docs/pool_format_levers.md. effect/interval/sample_blocks below record the ORIGINAL tie-break-inclusive measurement (matching the probability_positive already recorded, 0.865), not the RE-READ's tie-break-agnostic +0.92 pts / P+ 0.536-0.554 -- see docs/estimation_variance.md backfill for the reasoning.

windows.notes: PRIMARY (opener, production probability rule, week-blocked): -0.2193 pts, 95% [-3.3898, +2.6786] pts, P+=0.4246, paired games=456, blocks=35. Baseline arm reproduced the Section 8 information-read artifact game-for-game (max |prob diff| 0.00e+00) before half_life_8 was interpreted. Absolute accuracy: baseline 0.4803, candidate 0.4803. Season-blocked context (degenerate, 2 blocks): -0.2193 pts, P+=0.2535. Secondary (direction only): {"brier_improvement": {"estimate": 0.0005946240610264097, "lower": -0.0015082349785473072, "probability_positive": 0.7083, "upper": 0.0026650867359627943}, "log_loss_improvement": {"estimate": 0.0010761932324988618, "lower": -0.0032744484082736945, "probability_positive": 0.68405, "upper": 0.005353803394835452}}. SELECTION DISCLOSURE: (a) SELECTION INFLATION: half_life_8 was selected best-of-six on two screens (CFB clean-core week-blocked P+ 0.8987; NFL close-grade week-blocked P+ 0.8505 / season-blocked P+ 0.9533) and read a third time at the opener (P+ 0.2990, docs/era_weighting_screen.md Section 8) -- this confirmation is the arm's FOURTH look, not an independent blind draw. (b) POPULATION OVERLAP: the opener pool is 2020-2025 and the Section 8 information read scored ALL of it, so this window's games were already seen once; the two reads' P+ figures are not independent and are never multiplied. (c) MINED-LEDGER DISCOUNT: the window intersects 2018-2025 (~130-150-look ledger, ROADMAP RWB-16), acknowledged at declaration. (d) CROSS-FAMILY REUSE: [2020, 2021] was already spent by mod07_weak_signal_stack and best_pick_ranker_opener; rule 4 permits per-family retirement, global multiplicity on these seasons rises accordingly. DECISION RULE: play decision under expected value graded at the opener; P+ >= 0.9 governs claims only. Binding taxonomy: an interval containing zero is NEVER grounds to reject/close (expected shape for a real small signal at this evaluator's resolution). Only a RESOLVED wrong sign (whole interval below zero) or a positive-control bound may close a line of work; no positive control was run, so only wrong_sign_resolved is ever available and only when the whole week-blocked interval sits below zero. Otherwise: unresolved_below_power, reported with probability_positive.

graph_ratings_v2_team_stat.description: Graph ratings v2, team_stat arm: does opponent-adjusting a screened pregame team statistic through the signed-Katz schedule graph beat that statistic's raw home-minus-away differential on forced-pick ATS accuracy? Predeclared in docs/graph_ratings_v2_screen.md. Structural hyperparameters frozen from the CFB fit (alpha 0.85, half-life 8 weeks, max_row_l1 1.0) and not retuned on NFL; the raw differential is the paired control and the primary quantity is treatment-minus-control. Variant of MOD-15's PageRank/HITS schedule graph (recorded as graph_schedule_rating_brier, unresolved_below_power, docs/closure_audit.md); inputs are the 38 cluster representatives from the 2026-08-26 input screen, which were chosen by 2020-2025 opener holdout probability_positive, so that window is a spent selection surface for exactly these families. DISCLOSED PRIOR LOOK: a one-family, one-season plumbing smoke test (def_takeaway_rate, 2012) ran before this declaration to verify the harness end to end; its number changed no design decision, all of which were frozen in the predeclaration first.

windows.notes: 38 cluster representatives from the 2026-08-26 input screen, each as graph-propagated (signed Katz, frozen CFB structure) vs its own raw home-minus-away differential as the paired control; 746 games, 51 weeks, close-graded 2011-2013. Headline is the random-effects pool of the 38 commensurable per-family deltas (registry family graph_ratings_v2_team_stat): -0.107 accuracy points, 95% [-0.424, +0.209], tau^2 0.133. Two caveats stated rather than implied. (1) The pool assumes independence and these 38 cells share the SAME 746 games and the same market baseline, so the interval overstates precision; the per-entry rows are the safer read. (2) probability_positive here is the normal-approximation P(effect>0) from the pooled estimate and SE, NOT a fraction of blocked resamples -- the per-family entries carry real week-blocked resample fractions. SUBSTANTIVE FINDING: against zero the arm leans slightly negative (mean -0.123 pts, 12 of 38 positive), but a 200-permutation within-week null shows that lean is the home-tilt artifact, not the transform -- the arms carry 55-67 percent home-pick rates against a 49.67 percent cover rate, and the null is therefore not zero-centred by design. Referenced to each family's OWN null the arm is a coin flip: median percentile 50.2, 19 of 38 above their null centre, sign test p=1.000, null-adjusted mean +0.007 points. Tails: 4 families at or below the 2.5th percentile of their own null, 1 at or above the 95th, none at or above the 97.5th, uncorrected across 38 cells. Best cells by the conservative reference: def_yards_per_play +2.145 pts (95.5th pct of its null), injury_skill_unavailability +1.340 (93.5th), off_sack_rate +2.949 (92.5th; the only family whose interval excludes zero on the positive side, P+ 0.987). off_rush_epa_per_play reads P+ 0.911 against zero but sits at the 53.5th percentile of its own null -- the clearest single case for why the null reference was built. CLOSE-graded: settles no play/no-play decision, and no terminal classification is drawn at this grade per the predeclaration. Two families (special_teams_lineup_continuity, injury_skill_epa_value_lost) hit training folds with no observed values, so those arms partly degenerate to the market baseline; disclosed, not excluded. Predeclared in docs/graph_ratings_v2_screen.md before any outcome was scored.
